confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by season and neighbourhood (Old San Juan vs Condado), so treat them as the least certain. The FX observation (RBA overview page, 15 Oct 2026, 4pm) was taken from a search result snippet and not opened directly; the 16 Oct figure from a third-party site was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a Caribbean leisure city that uses USD. Accommodation is set near US mainland tourist-city levels, and restaurant and drink prices sit somewhat below US mainland cities such as Miami. No single named listing was consulted.
